assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
This is precisely the clinical scenario for which this diagnostic monitoring service is indicated.

This addresses the medical necessity concern underlying the denial under Reason Code CO-197, which indicates that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
